images.scene: Mission Control, live: Control Ultimate Edition streaming to Nova on a Retroid Pocket 6
images.encoding: WebP quality 90 (cwebp 1.6.0, -q 90 -metadata none), original dimensions, no crop or compositing
images.capture: Live 1.5.0 web UI of the installed Fedora package, rendered on the host in headless Chromium 149.0.7827.55 (Playwright 1.61.1), viewport 1289x864 at DPR 2 (2578x1728 pixels), native Linux platform, while the host streamed Control Ultimate Edition to Nova on a Retroid Pocket 6. Captured through the read-only route: every host-origin non-GET aborted, websockets closed; the two anonymous public GETs api.github.com/repos/papi-ux/polaris/releases/latest and /releases let through (Accept and User-Agent only); every other foreign request aborted. Theme chosen in the throwaway browser profile only (localStorage polaris-theme); no host config writes.
images.disclosure: Client address text neutralized to "Local network": the route card's client line showed the device's LAN address, which the capture page rewrote to "Local network" in the browser only (the site capture script's documented label neutralization). Nothing else was changed.
